result.summary: The pedestrian environment features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning pads, and dedicated pedestrian signals. The street is a one-way corridor with mature trees providing a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner radius on the right allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: One-way traffic speed
hazards.description: One-way street design can encourage higher vehicle speeds due to lack of opposing traffic friction.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crossing to sidewalk level to increase pedestrian visibility and calm traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with brick row houses and mature trees. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there is a lack of visible marked crosswalks or traffic control devices at the immediate intersection, and the foreground is heavily blurred.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning surfaces, and pedestrian signals. The environment is a mix of residential and commercial buildings with well-maintained sidewalks and street lighting.

hazards.name: Utility pole proximity
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located right at the corner, which could slightly impede pedestrian movement or sightlines.
